objective: Granular approved-French-graph diagnostic and student learning pathway

tasks.title: Display per-skill successes separately from mastery
tasks.acceptance: Saved eligible counts match the result and progress views; no mastery-state mutation.

tasks.title: Preserve answer review and correction history
tasks.acceptance: Saved diagnostic answers and wrong-answer filter survive reload.

tasks.title: Keep guided practice separate from independent mastery
tasks.acceptance: Lost successful response retries exactly once, without changing diagnostic or skill estimates.

tasks.title: Explain assessed, untested and unsupported targets
tasks.acceptance: Every state/mode has student-readable wording; unsupported targets are not shown as weaknesses.

tasks.title: Trace a result to its supporting answers
tasks.acceptance: A teacher can identify which independent answers support one specific skill, including later checks.

tasks.title: Inventory existing granular profile tests
tasks.acceptance: Map tests to explicit distinctions and identify missing contrasts.

tasks.title: Implement reproducible profile trace runner
tasks.acceptance: Fixed inputs reproduce target, mode, difficulty, time, evidence and next-activity traces.

tasks.title: Verify verb-family and individual-verb contrasts
tasks.acceptance: Both known and weak sides are exercised independently; unresolved targets cannot pass by omission; failures become fixes.

tasks.title: Verify tense and agreement contrasts
tasks.acceptance: Both known and weak sides are exercised independently; unresolved targets cannot pass by omission; failures become fixes.

tasks.title: Verify grammar-construction contrasts
tasks.acceptance: Both known and weak sides are exercised independently; unresolved targets cannot pass by omission; failures become fixes.

tasks.title: Verify spelling contrasts
tasks.acceptance: Both known and weak sides are exercised independently; unresolved targets cannot pass by omission; failures become fixes.

tasks.title: Verify short-reading contrasts
tasks.acceptance: Both known and weak sides are exercised independently; unresolved targets cannot pass by omission; failures become fixes.

tasks.title: Verify guessing, skipping and contradictory responses
tasks.acceptance: Both known and weak sides are exercised independently; unresolved targets cannot pass by omission; failures become fixes.

tasks.title: Verify learning-driven refinement
tasks.acceptance: Guided success alone cannot confirm mastery; independent post-lesson evidence can refine the exact target.

tasks.title: Run contrasting complete deployed journeys
tasks.acceptance: Fresh profiles finish in 30–40 active minutes, resume correctly, retain separate skill signals and receive suitable activities.

tasks.title: Reconcile current delivery gaps against route inventory
tasks.acceptance: Each remaining student route/version has a concrete missing-material list.

tasks.title: Complete capture of practice-player material
tasks.acceptance: Record exact visible and pre-delivered material before exposure; rendering and failure tests cover the route.

tasks.title: Complete capture of production-player material
tasks.acceptance: Record exact visible and pre-delivered material before exposure; rendering and failure tests cover the route.

tasks.title: Complete capture of reading and feedback material
tasks.acceptance: Record exact visible and pre-delivered material before exposure; rendering and failure tests cover the route.

tasks.title: Complete capture of dictation material
tasks.acceptance: Record exact visible and pre-delivered material before exposure; rendering and failure tests cover the route.

tasks.title: Complete capture of legacy diagnostic and demonstration material
tasks.acceptance: Record exact visible and pre-delivered material before exposure; rendering and failure tests cover the route.

tasks.title: Complete client-version and offline accounting
tasks.acceptance: Old clients, account switches, offline packs and errors cannot silently establish complete history.

tasks.title: Validate and release atomic covered delivery
tasks.acceptance: Native database concurrency/rollback checks and deployed route evidence pass; apply only verified migration.

tasks.title: Verify a fresh covered student baseline
tasks.acceptance: Known versus unseen words/sentences have source receipts; interrupted deliveries fail closed; historical students remain incomplete.

tasks.title: Activate complete-history contract
tasks.acceptance: Enable only supported versions/routes, then verify fresh independent evidence and rollback behavior.

tasks.title: Inventory all remaining graph targets
tasks.acceptance: Exactly 184 unsupported approved target IDs have requirements, dependencies and individually tracked work.

tasks.title: Implement the first missing target family
tasks.acceptance: Questions, lessons and independent checks satisfy the approved target contracts; preserve owner review status.

tasks.title: Validate each content batch before release
tasks.acceptance: Bundle checksums, target bindings, difficulty range and teaching/question separation pass.

tasks.title: Publish verified content batches
tasks.acceptance: Immutable bank and application deploy together; new target is exercised publicly; coverage registry updates.

tasks.title: Verify complete 544-target coverage
tasks.acceptance: Every target has released questions, independent checks and a usable pathway; no placeholders counted as coverage.

tasks.title: Prepare teacher review and observation record
tasks.acceptance: Teacher can record target-level agreement, disagreement, confusing wording and inappropriate activities.

tasks.title: Define and verify the supervised pilot scope
tasks.acceptance: State supported targets, provisional evidence limits, data persistence and support workflow; scope is explicit.

tasks.title: Prepare student pilot access and recovery
tasks.acceptance: Dedicated accounts enter the correct stage, can resume and open lessons without affecting the demo.

tasks.title: Collect owner content review in parallel
tasks.acceptance: Actual owner decisions recorded with content version and comments; never substitute automated review.

tasks.title: Observe real students and compare teacher judgments
tasks.acceptance: Document actual use, timing, skill-level disagreements and recommended-lesson suitability.

tasks.title: Fix and recheck pilot findings
tasks.acceptance: Each discrepancy has a reproducible case, validated resolution and deployed version.

releaseRule: Coordinator integrates only validated changes; candidate verification precedes promotion and public verification. Owner review continues in parallel and is not fabricated.

releases.scope: Existing baseline: 360/544 targets; results and progress counts verified on 19 eligible skills.
